Proposing a trade for Brick is unlikely to succeed given the robber situation, but I'll check if Charlie is willing to part with a Brick if he even has one (he likely doesn't as he's hunting it too). I'll save the Monopoly for when there's a higher concentration of a specific resource (like Ore or Wheat) or when I specifically need a mass of Brick/Wood to finish my path to the port.
